plain.li: That was my {THING}.
Days of work on that {THING}, and look at it.
I'll build it again. Not today.
That took me the better part of a week.
I can still see where I fixed the joint.
[afterraid] They came all this way to break that?

warm.li: At least nobody was standing next to it.

cheerful.li: Well. Now I know how to build a better one.

gloomy.li: Everything we make here ends up like that.
I knew that {THING} wouldn't last.

cold.li: Note the damage. I'll want the materials to rebuild.

plain.li: The {THING}. All those rows.
I sowed every one of those by hand.
There goes the {THING}.
I should have cut it sooner.
[winter] One frost, and that's the season gone.
Back to the seed sacks, then.

warm.li: We'll sow again. The soil's still good.

cheerful.li: Next year's {THING} will be twice the size. You'll see.

gloomy.li: We'll be hungry for this later.
Weeks of weeding, for nothing.

cold.li: Count what's left. We'll need to buy food.

plain.li: I'm sorry. I'm so sorry.
My hand slipped. It shouldn't have.
Somebody else should look at {OTHER_nameDef} next time.
I need to sit down.
I did everything right. I thought I did.
Fetch someone steadier than me.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef}, I'll make this right. I promise.

gloomy.li: I shouldn't be the one holding the knife.

plain.li: So it's {AMBITION}, then. Fine.
I still think {MINE} was the better plan.
Next meeting, I'm bringing it up again.
I thought I'd made my case.
Half of them weren't listening anyway.
We'll see how {AMBITION} goes.

warm.li: {AMBITION} it is. I'll help, even so.

blunt.li: Why do I bother standing up at these things?

gloomy.li: Nobody ever listens to me at these meetings.

cold.li: Noted. I won't forget who voted how.

plain.li: Is there really nothing left?
Some feast. I got the smell of it.
Next time I'm going to the table first.
Someone ate two. I saw it.
I set the tables and got nothing.
Bread and water at a feast.

cheerful.li: I'll just eat the crumbs, then. Very festive.

gloomy.li: Of course it ran out before I got there.

plain.li: Who decided to hold it outside?
My shoes are full of water.
Can we move this under a roof?
The fire's out, and so is the fun.
Someone fetch a tarp.
[child] Can we go inside now?

cheerful.li: Dancing in the rain! Well, standing in it.

gloomy.li: Even the sky didn't want this to happen.

plain.li: The {THING} I built is gone. I went to look at the spot this evening. There isn't much left.
Somebody asked me if I'd rebuild the {THING}. I said yes. I didn't mean it yet.
Picked through what was left of my {THING}. Kept one piece.
All that work on the {THING}, and it came down in a morning.

warm.li: Lost the {THING} today. Everyone's alive, so I'm trying to keep it in proportion.

gloomy.li: I don't know why I build anything here. It all ends up as rubble.
The {THING} is gone. I keep looking at the empty place where it stood.

cold.li: The {THING} is a loss. I've worked out what it will take to replace it.

plain.li: The {SUBJECT} took the {THING}. {COUNT} plants, and I sowed most of them myself.
Walked the field this morning. The {THING} is finished.
Cut down what was left of the {THING} today. It went on the compost.
We'll have to sow the {THING} again. If there's still time.

warm.li: Lost the {THING}. We'll manage. We always do.

gloomy.li: The {THING} is gone and I keep thinking about the winter.
I sowed that field row by row. It took the {SUBJECT} less than a day.

cold.li: {COUNT} plants of {THING} lost to {SUBJECT}. We'll need to trade for food.

plain.li: The operation on {OTHER_nameDef} went wrong. I keep going over it.
Couldn't sleep. I keep seeing my hands during the operation on {OTHER_nameDef}.
Went to see {OTHER_nameDef} after. I didn't know what to say.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} told me it wasn't my fault. It was.

gloomy.li: I should never have picked up the knife. {OTHER_nameDef} trusted me.

cold.li: Operation on {OTHER_nameDef}: failed. Reviewing what went wrong.

plain.li: The council went with {AMBITION}. I argued for {MINE}. I still think I was right.
Lost at the meeting. {MINE} will have to wait.
They chose {AMBITION}. I'll do my share of it, but I won't pretend I'm pleased.

warm.li: {AMBITION} won. It's a good idea too, I suppose. Mine was better.

gloomy.li: I don't know why I stand up at those meetings.

cold.li: They turned down {MINE}. I'll bring it back when they've seen {AMBITION} fail.

plain.li: The council promised {OTHER_nameDef} "{WISH}", and never did it. I saw {OTHER_possessive} face.
{OTHER_nameDef} has stopped mentioning "{WISH}". That's worse than complaining.
They broke their word to {OTHER_nameDef}. I'll remember that the next time they promise me something.

warm.li: Sat with {OTHER_nameDef} after the council let {OTHER_objective} down. We didn't say much.

cold.li: The council's promises are worth nothing. {OTHER_nameDef} is the proof.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is better at {SKILL} than I am now. Everyone noticed before I did.
I used to be the one they asked about {SKILL}. Now they ask {OTHER_nameDef}.
Watched {OTHER_nameDef} work today. It was good. I hated that it was good.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has a real gift for {SKILL}. I should be glad. I'm working on it.

gloomy.li: I was the best at {SKILL} here. Not any more.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has overtaken me at {SKILL}. I'll practise until that changes.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I don't talk the way we used to. I'm not sure when that started.
Ate across from {OTHER_nameDef} tonight. We talked about the weather.
I almost went to find {OTHER_nameDef} after work, like I used to. Then I didn't.

warm.li: I miss {OTHER_nameDef}, and {OTHER_pronoun} lives a few rooms away.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I are done being close, apparently.

gloomy.li: Friends drift. {OTHER_nameDef} has drifted a long way.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I no longer have much to say to each other. It's simpler.

plain.li: Hard week. I keep thinking about the place I grew up.
Dreamt of the house I lived in as a child. Woke up here.
I wonder if anyone back home still talks about me.
Tried to remember the sound of my mother's voice tonight.

warm.li: This place is home now. It just doesn't feel like it this week.

gloomy.li: Everyone I knew before is a long way off, or gone. This week I feel it.

cold.li: I've been thinking about leaving. Not seriously. Not yet.

plain.li: They sold "{TITLE}" today. I made that for us.
"{TITLE}" went off with the trader. I didn't go out to watch.
I'd have liked to be asked before they sold "{TITLE}".

gloomy.li: Somewhere out there a stranger has "{TITLE}" in their hall, and doesn't know my name.

cold.li: "{TITLE}" fetched a price, I suppose. I'll make the next one less easy to sell.

plain.li: Missed the gathering. Everyone was talking about it at supper.
Heard the music from where I was. Wished I'd been there.
They saved me nothing from the gathering. I wasn't expecting them to.

cheerful.li: Missed the gathering, so I'm making everyone tell me about it twice.

gloomy.li: Another gathering I wasn't at. They'll have stopped noticing.

plain.li: A feast, and I went to bed hungry. The meals ran out before I sat down.
Got to the table as the last plate went. I had bread.
Next feast, somebody should count the plates before we start.

blunt.li: Feast. No food left for me. Great.

cheerful.li: Missed out at the feast, but the company was good. My stomach disagrees.

plain.li: It rained on the gathering. We stayed out longer than we should have.
Everyone stood under the one bit of shelter, shoulder to shoulder, dripping.
Rain on the day we'd planned to be outside. My boots are still drying by the fire.

cheerful.li: Rained the whole gathering long. Somebody started singing anyway, and it helped.

gloomy.li: Of course it rained. It always rains when we try to have a nice time.

plain.li: Ate outside again. The food was cold before I'd finished.
Supper in the open. My fingers were too numb to hold the spoon properly.
We need somewhere under a roof to eat.

gloomy.li: Hunched over my bowl outside while the weather did its worst.

plain.li: Carried things from one end of the colony to the other all day. My shoulders ache.
Somebody should put the stockpile where the work is.
I must have walked the length of the colony twenty times today.

cheerful.li: All that hauling, and I've learned the name of every stone on the path.

plain.li: Bad work today. I know better, and it still came out wrong.
Spent the evening looking at what I made and seeing every flaw.
Had to do it the slow way again. A proper bench would make all the difference.

gloomy.li: Maybe I'm not as good as I thought I was.

cold.li: An off day at the bench. I've worked out where I went wrong.

plain.li: They took down something I built. Nobody asked me first.
Watched them pull apart what I put up. It came down a lot faster than it went up.
I suppose it wasn't needed any more. I still liked it.

cold.li: Something of mine was dismantled today. I'll remember the hours it cost.

plain.li: The council decided against me again. I said my piece. That's all I can do.
I don't agree with what the council's doing. I'm writing it down so I remember I said so.
Still waiting on the council. They seem to get round to everyone else.
Another day under that decree. Another day nobody asked us.

warm.li: I don't agree with the council this time, but they're trying. I'll give them that.

gloomy.li: The council doesn't hear people like me.

cold.li: I've started keeping a list of the council's mistakes. It's getting long.

plain.li: Nothing happened today. Nothing happened yesterday either.
Work, food, bed. I'd give a lot for something new to do of an evening.
We haven't had a proper get-together in I don't know how long.

cheerful.li: Made up a game with three stones and a cup. It's terrible. I've played it all evening.

gloomy.li: The days here run together like water.

plain.li: Couldn't settle to anything today. I kept thinking about someone I care about.
Checked on them three times. Nothing's changed.
Worry is a tiring thing. I'm going to bed early.

warm.li: I'll take them something warm tomorrow, and sit a while.

gloomy.li: I keep imagining the worst. I can't seem to stop.

plain.li: Lay in bed hurting for hours before anyone came. I counted the beams in the ceiling.
Somebody finally saw to my wounds. It took them long enough.
We need more than one person here who can doctor.

gloomy.li: I wondered for a while if anyone would come at all.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was working next door half the night. I heard every blow.
Asked {OTHER_nameDef} to keep it down after dark. We'll see.
No sleep. {OTHER_nameDef} and that racket through the wall.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} kept me up all night working, so at least something got done.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} said something about me today that I won't repeat here.
Still annoyed with {OTHER_nameDef}. I'll get over it, probably by tomorrow.
{OTHER_nameDef} has a way of making things my fault.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} hurt my feelings today. I don't think {OTHER_pronoun} meant to.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has made an enemy, if {OTHER_pronoun} isn't careful.
